notes.title: Over 10,000 Unique Players
notes.content:
A huge thank you to everyone who’s played the game!
We’ve officially hit 10,000 total players, and honestly, I’m still trying to wrap my head around it.

When I first started working on this project, I had no idea where it would go or if anyone would even play it. I just knew I wanted to make something fun, something I’d enjoy myself — and to see so many of you jump in and enjoy it too has been amazing.

This journey has been a massive learning experience for me. From design and development to balancing game play and listening to feedback — it’s been eye-opening in the best way. But more than anything, the biggest lesson I’ve learned is how important you, the players, are in shaping this game. Your support, feedback, and encouragement have played a huge role in getting it to where it is now. This has never felt like a solo project — it truly feels like something we’ve built together.

So again, thank you all so much. Whether you’ve just started playing or you’ve been here from the beginning, I’m incredibly grateful. I hope the game has brought you some joy along this journey.

Here’s to whatever comes next!

notes.title: Core Gameplay Loop changed
notes.content:
Hello,

After lots of feedback, I have changed the main game play mechanic loop, no longer can you sit on 30 hp with enough attack to 1 shot monsters, they attack first!
A lot of people were rightly upset that there was a "strat" that rapidly increased the game play speed and this meant it got a bit boring quickly,

Now you are required to buy some health,

Changed how the ascension bonus is calculated, this now goes off the highest level the player has reached and not what level your equipment is, this encourages players to try and get higher levels rather than just reaching 10m and ascending, also I lowered the ascension level to 5 million, but this has a lower bonus, so will you play rapid and ascend multiple times or go for a higher bonus by getting higher levels?

Added was some feedback on when prestige is available, and when ascension is available, this is just a pop up test in upper left to show when this is available.

Can no longer just click the keep button in the skyforge to set your equipment back to 0-0-0 by accident, you now have to craft before these become active.

Put a limit on Max Health - 2B, and max health cost - 2B

I really hope you all like this new change, as its been a recurring suggestion 😄 I do listen and take this all onboard!

notes.title: FPS Limiter / Unlimiter
notes.content:
I have added an FPS option in the main landing page,

This will allow you to "cap" the game speed to 60x, if your pc is struggling to run the game at full speed I would reccomend this.

Alternatively, if your Monitor is a 60Hz monitor and you want to run the game at the full 144FPS intended, then you can select the 144 FPS option, however your GPU may still FPS lock you if you do not turn off VSync on your graphical card options.

Please note that the Game speed is tied to FPS, even if you buy up to 143x speed but run a 60Hz monitor you will only get 60x speed.
